overall: The AG found the Bourne Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law on its June 16 meeting notice (missing bargaining unit detail and unclear meeting time) and by entering executive session without first convening in open session. It found no violation on the complaints/charges topic detail or the missing open-session listing, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the executive session topic for complaints or charges against a person lacked sufficient detail.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by omitting that information from the first executive session topic.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the collective bargaining executive session topic did not identify the bargaining unit or units involved.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board should have listed in the notice that it would be negotiating with all units.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the notice did not list an open session before the executive session topics. AG found no separate listing was needed.
allegations.key_passage: Here, it was clear that an open session meeting would take place, thus the Board was not required to separately list "open session" as a topic in the notice for its June 16 meeting.

allegations.summary: AG-raised issue, not in the complaint: notice gave a 6:15 PM call to order and a 7:00 PM start, so the meeting time was unclear.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the notice violated the Open Meeting Law by not clearly stating the time of the meeting.

allegations.summary: AG-raised issue, not in the complaint: the Board entered executive session without first convening in open session and voting to enter.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board convened its June 16 executive sessions without first convening in open session and voting to enter into executive session.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Board that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
